name: Angular
description: Angular is a popular, TypeScript-based, open-source front-end framework developed by Google for building dynamic, scalable, and modern single-page web applications (SPAs). It uses a component-based architecture to enhance modularity and code reusability, allowing developers to create complex applications with a comprehensive, well-integrated set of tools.

name: React
description: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.

name: Vue
description: Vue.js is a progressive, open-source JavaScript framework for building modern, interactive user interfaces (UIs) and Single-Page Applications (SPAs). It acts as the 'view' layer of applications, specializing in declarative rendering, component-based architecture, and reactive data binding to synchronize UI with data efficiently.

name: Git
description: Git is a free, open-source distributed version control system used primarily by developers to track and manage changes to source code over time. It acts like a 'time machine' for projects, allowing you to save snapshots of your work so you can revert to earlier versions if something breaks.
